The '''Remains of the Innocent''' are a boss in [[Stormwrought Ruins]]. It is an amalgamation of the liquified remains of the people of [[Northwind]] abducted by the [[Stormreaver clan]].

==Abilities==
* Diseased Slime
* Noxious Cloud

==Objective of==
* {{questlong|Horde|34D|Innocence Lost}}

==Loot==
* [[Tiny Bracelet]]
* [[Bloodied Almanac]]
* [[Northwind Guard Breeches]]
* [[Dissolved Hookblade]]

==Notes==
[[File:Chamber Lever locations.png|thumb|The locations of the levers.]]
In order to open the gate leading to the Remains of the Innocent, four Chamber Levers must be pulled. Their locations are:
# To the left immediately after entering the Sanctum of Blood, in the dead end with two [[Blooddrained Carcass]]es.
# In the last alcove on the upper floor, up the right ramp.
# Behind a pillar in the room preceding [[Lady Drazare]]'s boss room.
# In the back of the last left-most alcove in Lady Drazare's boss room.
